name: Log-In Logística Intermodal S.A.
summary: Log-in Logística Intermodal S.A. engages in the provision of integrated logistics solutions for moving and transporting door-to-door containers and cargo in Brazil, Austria, and internationally. It operates through Integrated Solutions, Port Terminal, and Road Cargo Transport segments. The company offers cabotage services; coastal shipping and maritime services; warehousing, separation, and cross-dock services; and storage services for containers and general cargo, as well as manages and operates container port terminals.
